deployments_detail.use: Conversational AI technical support assistant that answers connector spec/materials questions, does natural-language product discovery across the catalog, gives design guidance and connector comparison/selection; multi-agent architecture (Product Search, Technical Expert, QC Validation agents) over an LLM + vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate), FastAPI backend, embeddable React widget.
